access.notes: Open-source molecular dynamics simulator; any equivalent MD package (e.g., OpenMM, GROMACS) that supports TIP4P can be used.
Standard TIP4P parameters: σ_OO=3.154 Å, ε=0.155 kcal/mol, q_H=0.52e, q_M=-1.04e, geometry r_OH=0.975 Å, r_OM=0.15 Å, ∠HOH=104.5°. Implement directly in the MD script.
